name: curse-engine (The Straw Effigy), Nguyen Anh, foreseen
unmodelled: Driven Nail (identity): each curse laid shortens the longest-cooldown art's timer by 0.5 s, 3 per pulse. fight_calc has no timer-move action; the Nail here runs on its plain 3.0 s cooldown. See the sheet's paper model

The Litany (the Effigy's rule): first missing curse in order, skipping reapply lockouts. fight_calc gives each trigger one fixed curse, so the litany is approximated by two triggers and the arts' own curses
Sealed Meridian (the litany's first name: the enemy's L2 counts as 1.0, 2 pulses, 2-pulse reapply lockout): no layer-lock field in fight_calc

Sundered and Exposed are resistance in points under the current GDDs (-150 per stack, -100 all, below 0 amplifies). fight_calc still models the pre-#44 body guard and ward pass, so they are mapped to shred (0.17 x 3 stacks, clipped at 0.5) and pass_raise 0.5: a large understatement
Weight of Names reads curse stacks (+10 each, cap +80); fight_calc reads curse count, so 20 per curse approximates two stacks per curse
Fourth Nail (curse_slots +1): fight_calc's curse_slots is a constant (3)
Backlash (the Effigy's close: a cleansed curse lands on you) and Ash of the Effigy (cleanse): no cleansing enemy in fight_calc
Paid in Nails is mapped to refund_qi_share 0.10 on every Nail firing; the real rule needs every litany curse on the target
Blood Drinker (6 % of direct damage as healing): no healing in fight_calc
Linh luc on hit (+0.19 pp per hit): not modelled
Paper Money Burning (heal) and Paper Boat Crossing (escape): not slotted here
fight_calc's art lint uses the pre-#44 12-per-cost rule; the arts are authored at the current 24-per-cost lint (combat.md Formulas C)
v1 pierce_pct 0
v1 guard {"a_b": 0.3, "t_b": 0, "body_guard_pct": 20}

v1 triggers [{"id": "effigy", "source": "art", "chance": 1.0, "curse": {"id": "sundered", "shred": 0.17, "duration": 4}}, {"id": "effigy", "source": "basic", "chance": 1.0, "curse": {"id": "heavy_breath", "cost_raise": 0.5, "duration": 4}}]

v1 conditional_mods [{"id": "weight_of_names", "layer": 5, "per": "enemy_curses", "points_per": 20, "channels": ["art", "basic"]}, {"id": "marked_prey", "layer": 5, "per": "enemy_curses", "points_per": 4, "channels": ["art", "basic"]}]
v1 ward shape {"pass": {"body": 0.3, "qi": 0.3}, "drain": {"body": 1.0, "qi": 1.5}} (pass and drain shares are retired; modelled as the Common Ward at this ws and we, every ward layer at cap)
v1 art iron_nail guard {"who": "enemy", "status": "exposed"}
v1 art iron_nail refund_qi_share 0.1
v1 art slipper_blow curse {"id": "sundered", "shred": 0.17, "duration": 4}
v1 art straw_binding curse {"id": "exposed", "pass_raise": 0.5, "duration": 3}
_comment: Migrated from fight_calc.py format v1 by tools/design/combat_sim/migrate_fight_v1.py (2026-11-11). Art kinds: qi -> elem, body -> phys, no element stacks. Costs kept (post-#44 file). Ward: v1 ws and we kept, every ward layer at cap (top-end build). Everything with no new field is in unmodelled, prefixed v1.
